findings.issue: Development deploy workflow has no rollback capability
findings.impact: A bad development deploy can only be fixed by pushing a new commit. Images use mutable :dev tag, no SHA-pinned rollback job exists.
findings.fix: Add a rollback job mirroring the production rollback pattern: accept rollback_sha input, pull SHA-tagged images, re-tag as :dev, and redeploy.

findings.issue: Zero database rollback scripts exist across 34 migrations
findings.impact: Any schema migration causing data loss or performance regression requires destructive PITR instead of a simple rollback.
findings.fix: Generate down-migration stubs for each existing migration; add rollback plan to migration workflow; document forward-fix patterns.

findings.issue: Production rollback job omits --force-recreate from docker compose up
findings.impact: After re-tagging SHA images as :latest, docker compose may not detect the image change and leave old containers running.
findings.fix: Add --force-recreate to the rollback compose up command.

findings.issue: Incident response runbook does not document rollback trigger or procedure
findings.impact: On-call operators may not know how to initiate the production rollback workflow, delaying recovery during an outage.
findings.fix: Add a 'Rollback' subsection documenting how to find previous known-good SHA, trigger rollback from Actions UI, and verify success.
